title: analysis/status.json
description: Rewritten by analysis/host.py about every 5 s. `uptime_s`, `plugins.*.windows/records/errors/dropped` and `rx.*` are cumulative since the host started. `audio_written` is false unless the analyzer runs with `--clip-audio` (off by default, never passed by the supervisor) and the wildlife clip capture (analysis/clips.py, interface `clips`) wrote at least one audio file since this host started; it is the ONLY audio the analyzer can write (certainty > 0.85, never near speech, deleted after 24 h; see specs/clips.md). In the default visual-only mode it stays false. 2.0.0: it was the constant false in 1.x, so a reader that treated true as a violation must now read `clips`.

meta.description: 1.1.0, optional. Cumulative error and degradation counters of the history writers (nothing here ever stops the analyzer): write_errors and rotate_fallbacks of the rotating JSONL writers, taxa_missing (rows stamped group null because ui/taxa.json was absent) and taxa_unmapped (genus not in the table), config_write_errors, rollup_errors, daily_flush_errors, history_dropped (records for an hour already closed). Optional extra counter coherence_errors (coherence plugin: windows refused for non-finite input or wrong shape, or failed). Optional extra counter indices_errors (indices plugin: windows refused, non-finite or failed, plus windows excluded for lack of tagger coverage).

device.description: Torch device chosen at start (the GPU with the most free VRAM, cpu if none has 1.5 GB).

contiguous_s.description: Length of the aligned contiguous audio ring right now.

clips.description: 2.0.0, optional (absent with --no clips or when clip capture could not start). Live state of the wildlife clip capture; the counters are in `meta` (clips_*, clip_*, audio_expired, audio_expire_retry, orphans_deleted, sweep_runs, sweep_errors).

audio.description: --clip-audio is on. false (default): visual-only, audio_files is 0 and status audio_written stays false.

pending.description: Open events plus finished clips waiting in RAM for the speech-guard verdict.

plugin.description: One entry per plugin, three shapes. Off (`enabled` false): `reason` says why (missing model, import error, --no); the others keep running. Derived (novelty, fed by the tags embeddings): `enabled` true and only a `note`. Running: window counters plus the last timestamp and error.
